svg.title: Extract into the OD phase with methanol · conceptual
svg.desc: Add methanol; retain CdSe NCs in the OD phase and remove excess coordinating solvent and unreacted precursors in the methanol phase. Repeat the extraction four times as stated. Methanol amount and exact phase volumes are not supplied. Conceptual action diagram. Vessel type, shape, volume, fill and physical continuity are not specified for this step. Arrows indicate an action only. No missing reactor value, phase handling or rate is inferred from this drawing.
